Battle Themes Collection: Pokémon, Vol. III

Album · March 2026 · 15 tracks

The third volume of arranged battle themes from across the Pokémon series, spanning Red & Blue through Scarlet & Violet. Includes arrangements made after Vol. 2 (November 2023) and before March 2026.
